quick.label: Quick
quick.title: Quick scan
quick.description: Fewer pages, common ports, basic security headers and sensitive-path checks. Good for a first pass to see whether the target has obvious problems.

standard.label: Standard
standard.title: Standard scan
standard.description: Default mode: crawls more entry points, runs SQL/XSS/CSRF/SSRF/NoSQL/SSTI/LFI and system vulnerability checks (HTTP methods/CRLF/Host header/default credentials/source leaks), with 6-role parallel AI review.

deep.label: Deep
deep.title: Deep scan
deep.description: More pages, a fuller port set, more sensitive paths and all payload variants, plus 6-role parallel AI discovery and review. Suits a formal investigation but takes longer.

stepDesc.validate: Checks whether the URL, directory path, model settings and scan parameters are usable.
stepDesc.loginState: Loads Cookie, Authorization and custom headers for pages that require login.
stepDesc.strategy: Picks crawl depth, page count, payload and sensitive-path scope for the quick, standard or deep mode.
stepDesc.crawl: Requests target pages and collects same-origin links, forms, parameters and testable entry points.
stepDesc.injection: Runs every injection type on URL parameters and form inputs: SQL injection (including blind and stacked), XSS, CSRF, SSRF, NoSQL, SSTI and LFI.
stepDesc.sensitivePaths: Probes common sensitive paths (Swagger, Actuator, config files, etc.), scans the target IP's open ports and identifies service usage.
stepDesc.tls: Checks HTTPS certificate validity, TLS protocol versions, self-signed certificates and other transport-layer issues.
stepDesc.systemVulns: HTTP method probing (TRACE/PUT/DELETE), CRLF injection, Host header injection, default-credential brute force (18 common pairs) and source-leak path scanning.
stepDesc.aiDiscover: Six roles (injection expert / auth audit / info disclosure / HTTP config / client security / infrastructure) analyze raw responses in parallel to find issues rule-based scanning missed.
stepDesc.aiReview: Six security roles review candidate findings in parallel, each validating findings within its domain, then dedupe and summarize the results.
stepDesc.save: Saves the scan results, counts findings by severity and writes to scan history.
